class.name: DebugDraw
class.brief_description: Draws shapes, text and values for a frame or a few seconds, to see what code is doing.
class.description:
Call [DebugDraw] from anywhere and the shape shows for that frame. Call it every frame for as long as you want the shape, or give it a [code]duration[/code] in seconds to leave it behind: [codeblock] func _physics_process(delta): DebugDraw.arrow(global_position, global_position + velocity, Color.YELLOW) DebugDraw.show_value("speed", velocity.length())
func _on_hit(at: Vector3): DebugDraw.point(at, 0.3, Color.ORANGE, 2.0) [/codeblock] 3D lines draw through what's in front of them faintly, so a shape behind a wall still shows where it is. 2D shapes are in the world's coordinates and move with the camera. Positions are global; with [WorldOrigin], shapes with a duration move with the world when it shifts. Shapes drawn during a physics tick stay until the next tick, so they don't flicker when frames and ticks don't line up. Everything drawn in a frame goes to the GPU as one mesh, so thousands of lines cost little. [DebugDraw] draws in debug builds. In release exports it draws nothing unless [code]debug_draw/enabled_in_release_builds[/code] is set, or the game sets [member enabled].

method.name: arrow
method.description: Draws a line from [param from] to [param to] with a head at [param to].

method.name: arrow_2d
method.description: Draws a 2D line from [param from] to [param to] with a head at [param to].

method.name: axes
method.description: Draws [param transform]'s axes as arrows [param size] long from its origin: X red, Y green, Z blue.

method.name: box
method.description: Draws the edges of a 1×1×1 cube transformed by [param transform], so it can be moved, rotated and stretched: [code]Transform3D(Basis.from_scale(size), center)[/code] is a box [code]size[/code] big around [code]center[/code].

method.name: circle_2d
method.description: Draws a circle of [param radius] around [param center].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes everything drawn, including shapes with a duration and values.

method.name: get_line_count
method.description: How many lines are waiting to be drawn (a 2D line counts as one too). Mostly for tests.

method.name: line
method.description: Draws a line from [param from] to [param to].

method.name: line_2d
method.description: Draws a 2D line from [param from] to [param to].

method.name: path
method.description: Draws lines joining [param points] in order, and the last back to the first if [param closed].

method.name: path_2d
method.description: Draws 2D lines joining [param points] in order, and the last back to the first if [param closed].

method.name: point
method.description: Draws a cross of three lines [param size] long, along the axes, at [param position].

method.name: show_value
method.description: Lists [param name] and [param value] in the top-left corner of the screen, for a frame or [param duration] seconds. Showing a name again replaces its value. Floats show three decimals.

method.name: sphere
method.description: Draws a sphere of [param radius] around [param center], as three circles.

method.name: text
method.description: Draws [param text] on screen, centred over [param position] in the world. Nothing shows when [param position] is behind the camera.

method.name: text_2d
method.description: Draws [param text] at [param position] in the world's 2D coordinates.

members.member: Whether shapes are drawn. Turning it off removes what's drawn, and calls draw nothing until it's turned back on.

If [code]true[/code], a panel in the top-right corner of the screen shows a graph of recent frame times, the frame rate, the CPU's process and physics times, the GPU's time and its five costliest render passes, and the draw calls, objects, primitives and video memory. The console's [code]perf[/code] command toggles it. Measuring the GPU's passes costs a little, so it only happens while this is on.
